name: AEP Ohio (Ohio Power Company)
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public aepohio.com pages (no sign-in). The site now says AEP Ohio does business as Ohio Power Company; brand shows both. Log in with User ID and Password. Fees from the Compare Payment Options table: one-time payments (BillMatrix) $1.85 per residential transaction, limit $2,500 per residential transaction (below the schema's $5,000 floor, so help only); AutoPay is free (bank only, paid on the due date, activation takes 3 business days online); paperless customers pay free by e-check. The format cannot make the in-account e-check fee depend on paperless enrollment, so bankCents is 0 (paperless route) and cardCents 185; guest pay (BillMatrix, no login) is $1.85 for bank or card. Phone payments through BillMatrix at 800-611-0964. Payment arrangements and one-time payment extensions are online after logging in. Stop service online.

One-time residential payments are limited to $2,500 each.

help.title: Compare payment options
paragraphs: Paying online from your checking account is free when you are enrolled in Paperless Billing. Other one-time payments, online, as a guest or by phone, go through BillMatrix and cost $1.85 per residential transaction, up to $2,500 per payment.

Pay as a guest makes a one-time payment without an online account. To pay by phone, call BillMatrix at 800-611-0964 with your account number; payments after 4:00 p.m. ET, on weekends or holidays post the next business day.
Cards accepted include Mastercard, Visa, Discover, American Express and Pulse, Accel, STAR and NYCE debit cards. You can also pay in person at CheckFree Pay locations or by mail.

help.title: AutoPay
paragraphs: AutoPay pays your bill from your bank account on the due date each month at no charge and sends you a message when it is paid. Card payments cannot be used for AutoPay.
Online enrollment takes about 3 business days to activate; mailed enrollment takes 4 to 6 weeks.

help.title: Payment assistance
paragraphs: A payment arrangement spreads your balance over a few months so you can pay it in full; log in to check eligibility or status. If you only need a few extra days on one bill, a one-time payment extension may be a better fit.
Average Monthly Payments make bills more predictable. Ohio programs such as PIPP Plus and HEAP may also help.

help.title: Paperless Billing
paragraphs: With Paperless Billing you get an email when your bill is ready, a reminder before it is due and free online payments from your checking account. You can see up to 13 months of bills and usage. Paper bills stop once you enroll.

help.title: View your bill
paragraphs: Log in to see your current bill, amount due and due date. Paperless Billing customers can see up to 13 months of billing and usage details.

help.title: Payment activity
paragraphs: Log in and open Payment Activity to see your recent payments. Bills and usage for up to 13 months are available to Paperless Billing customers.

help.title: Frequently asked questions
paragraphs: Ohio Power Company formerly did business as AEP Ohio; references to AEP Ohio on the site apply to Ohio Power Company.
Payments made after 4:00 p.m. ET, on a weekend or a holiday post on the next business day.

help.title: Stop service
paragraphs: To close your account, use the online stop service form under Start, Stop & Transfer Service. If you are moving out of the AEP Ohio service area, fill out the form once you know your move-out date. For help, call 800-672-2231.
